verdict.rationale: Svelte has no hosted service API to wrap (OpenAPI probes all 404). Its official building surfaces are its own first-party packages: the framework and SvelteKit, documented in LLM-oriented llms.txt files; the `sv` CLI with add-ons and a library template; the `@sveltejs/mcp` npm package; and a compiler that a community user reports importing programmatically. These amount to an SDK-like developer surface, but nothing is documented explicitly as an official SDK. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official SDK or programmatic API reference, multi-language SDK coverage, and independent corroboration of building against these packages as SDKs.
